summary: Historical context imported from the existing November 5 research notes. Not fresh November 6 news; external sources not rechecked during setup. No experiment or outreach is authorized by these proposals.

items.title: Can we spend less time chasing property records?
items.signal: Ploti says it connects parcel, zoning and permit records to AI, with links back to official sources.
items.evidence: Its product page describes the workflow. We have not checked SF coverage, pricing or accuracy.
items.limits: Historical import from existing research checked November 5, 2026; source not independently rechecked during this feed setup. Its product page describes the workflow. We have not checked SF coverage, pricing or accuracy.
items.why_it_matters: Build a property research sheet together. JJ makes a simple page that collects source-linked permit and zoning notes; Jess chooses the questions buyers actually ask and reviews the answers.
items.proposed_test: Start with one SF property and three questions from Jess. JJ builds the page using official records first. Time the research and have Jess flag every missing or misleading detail.

items.title: AI search still depends on MLS access.
items.signal: Solid Earth describes an AI assistant that turns plain-language questions into MLS searches.
items.evidence: Its October 28 walkthrough says results depend on the member’s permissions. It does not establish access for Jess.
items.limits: Historical import from existing research checked November 5, 2026; source not independently rechecked during this feed setup. Its October 28 walkthrough says results depend on the member’s permissions. It does not establish access for Jess.
items.why_it_matters: Build a search-request translator: Jess writes a real buyer request; JJ turns it into a checklist of listing filters and unanswered questions. Jess runs the search in her approved MLS.
items.proposed_test: Try five fictional buyer requests. Compare JJ’s generated filters with Jess’s own. Only explore an MLS connection after her provider confirms access.

items.title: The handoff matters as much as the call.
items.signal: CINC says Call AI can qualify an inquiry, transfer the caller and save a transcript and summary.
items.evidence: We rechecked its September 15 post. These are vendor claims; we have not tested call quality or results.
items.limits: Historical import from existing research checked November 5, 2026; source not independently rechecked during this feed setup. We rechecked its September 15 post. These are vendor claims; we have not tested call quality or results.
items.why_it_matters: Prototype an inquiry-to-follow-up tool. JJ builds a form that turns inquiry notes into a short summary and draft reply; Jess defines the must-have details and edits the tone.
items.proposed_test: Use ten fictional inquiries. Jess scores the summaries for missing details and whether the reply is usable. Start with pasted notes before adding voice calls.
